title: Photo cake orders for Vineyard and Riverstone — pickup open every Sunday
summary:
Most Sydney bakeries shut on Sunday. Riverstone doesn't — 7am to 7pm, every Sunday, for Vineyard and Riverstone families with a Sunday party on the calendar.

Send a photo of the cake you want and we recreate it — in buttercream, fondant or ganache — for $19.99 on top of the base price. Six sizes, 15 flavours, 100% eggless. Not most cakes. Every cake.

48 hours minimum notice. That's what fresh baking actually takes, weekend included. Free parking at Riverstone Shopping Centre — no searching for a spot with a cake box on the back seat.

Order via WhatsApp: +61 425 697 725.
